notes.per_0p1px: parameter / mapping change divided by (perturbation size / 0.1 px); y-scale: size = max shift 5e-4*540 = 0.27 px
notes.mapping: rotation-compensated displacement between the unperturbed and the perturbed estimate (evaltools.mapping_displacement), median / max of |displacement| over the region's grid points (grid 40 px); plumb-line estimates are expressed as a mapping at f = f_true (synthetic) or f = 1400 (real)
notes.starts: same start for the unperturbed and the perturbed run (real: the orchestrator's starts; synthetic: the truth)
